# Will this product feed get items disapproved?

> Paste a Google Merchant Center or Meta Catalog feed to find missing fields, bad GTINs and malformed prices before products are disapproved. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
